questions.question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Sea of Poppies'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __Amitav Ghosh__**.

• At the heart of this vibrant saga is a vast ship,** the Ibis**.
 
• Her destiny is a tumultuous voyage across the Indian Ocean shortly before the outbreak of the** Opium Wars in China**.

questions.question: How many Tirthas are mentioned in Kautilya’s ‘Arthashastra’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**18**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Arthashastra was written by Kautilya.
 
• There are **18 t****irthas **are mentioned in Kautilya’s ‘Arthashastra’.
 
• Kautilya was Prime Minister of the Mauryan empire and also an academician at Taxila University.
 
• Arthashastra deals with the qualities and disciplines needed for a king to rule his empire.
 
• According to Kautilya, a king is one who is always active in promoting the protection and welfare of the people.
 
• Kautilya has for the first time defined the state in Arthashastra.
 
• According to him, a State consists of people and the ruler who controlled the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chanakya was a teacher, philosopher, economist, jurist, and royal counsellor in ancient India.
 
• He is popularly referred to as Kautilya or Vishnugupta, the author of the Arthashastra, an ancient Indian political treatise that dates from the 4th century BCE to the 3rd century CE.
 
• He is regarded as India's political science and economics pioneer, and his work is regarded as an essential forerunner to classical economics.
 
• Chanakya aided Chandragupta, the first Mauryan emperor, in his climb to power. He is usually recognized as being a key figure in the creation of the Maurya Empire.
 
• Both Chandragupta and his son Bindusara had Chanakya as their principal counsel.
 
• Kautilya (Chanakya), the famed author of the Arthasastra, was the Prime Minister of the Mauryan Empire's emperor Chandragupta.
